units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:2">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>שקלינן צ׳ וכ׳</he> we get a pair of tongs and take the serpent away … and save the cask.

<cite ref="Pesachim 54a:7">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>צַבְתָּנָא בצ׳ מתעבדא צ׳</he> … <he>עבדה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>צ׳ בצ׳ מתעביד וכ׳</he>) our tongs are made with the help of tongs: who made the first tongs? Therefore the first tongs must have been a natural object; Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 23 (v. <cite ref="L00016"><he>לַאי</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 1:9">Tosef. Ḥag. I, 9</cite> (applied to the numerous laws derived from a meagre text); expl.

Y. Erub. X, end, 26ᵈ מצ׳ אחת למדו צביתות הרבה וכ׳ from handling one pair of tongs (found as a natural object) they learned many manipulations with the tongs: so they derived numerous forbidden Sabbath labors by analogy from one intimated in the text.—Trnsf. instrumentality.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 9b:16">B.
